You are purchasing a "VTG Lot New/Sealed & Open Blank 8-Track Tapes & Some Pop Seals & Crofts Xmas " in "Used" condition.
Lot of vintage 8-track stereo tapes and blank cartridges, perfect for collectors, retro audio fans, or display in a classic music room. This mixed lot includes various artists plus a stack of sealed blank 8-track cartridges. Several music titles are still in their original wrap, with others showing that great vintage patina—worn edges, creases, and rubbed corners that tell their age and history. The sealed blanks are ideal if you like recording your own mixes on original-format media. Whether you’re rebuilding a vintage 8-track collection, looking for period-correct decor, or just love old-school audio, this bundle gives you a nice mix of titles and blanks in one shot. 277710387.description: This vintage lot includes drafting and engineering tools from manufacturers like Dietzgen and Staedtler. The set features multiple compasses, dividers, and precision drafting instruments housed in original velvet-lined and leather cases, along with a Staedtler Marsmatic 700 technical pen set complete with a case and ink bottle. Several vintage slide rules, including a Dietzgen model, are included, as well as a 1965 desk calendar, metal and wooden rulers, and various small paper and metal desk accessories. Most items show signs of age and use, including some wear on cases and paper, but remain in collectible and functional condition.
